title: Agent demo freezes research, scopes private access and guards planned media import and replay
steps: Run the deterministic agent demo capability tests.
expect: Full source and media catalogue is hashed and paginated beyond asset24.
Provision-only requires a frozen server revision and active action.
Foreign account/site/session and arbitrary URL imports are refused.
Plan persists before writes; revocation, Stop, corrupt bytes and uncertain receipts block later writes.
Confirmed import replay returns its existing receipt without a second upload.
